turns.text: Hale. Who decided on the zero?
The checker said 94%, so it's a zero.
A machine's guess. What else do you have?
I'm sorry I didn't call. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit.
I want to see that history myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the history. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: showing the version history with its times, a fact she can check.
What cost ground: leading with the checker score, the one thing she came ready for.
What she never said: in October she saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop at 1 AM and never asked; the late-night times came close to that night; it proves nothing, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: open with the apology and the version history, before any score.
